newsitem.title: USA: Banner stake raised by Cramer group.
newsitem.headline: Banner stake raised by Cramer group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager J.J. Cramer & Co on Wednesday said it raised its stake in Banner Aerospace Inc to 2,453,900 common shares, or 10.5 percent of the total.
The group previously held 9.4 percent of Banner's shares outstanding.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest purchases were made between February 21 and May 1 at prices ranging from $6.875 to $8.625 per share.
Banner shares closed up 1/8 at 7-1/4 on Wednesday.
Banner, based in Cleveland, distributes new and overhauled replacement parts for the aviation after-market.
